JVNDB-2026-000113
Improper file access permission settings in Synology Assistant
Overview
Synology Assistant provided by Synology Inc. contains the following vulnerability.
Incorrect default permissions (CWE-276) - CVE-2026-4793
Kazuma Matsumoto of GMO Cybersecurity by IERAE, Inc. reported this vulnerability to IPA.
JPCERT/CC coordinated with the developer under Information Security Early Warning Partnership.

Affected Products
Synology Inc.
Synology Assistant versions prior to 7.0.7
Impact
Arbitrary code may be executed with SYSTEM privileges by a user who can access the device that the affected product is installed.
Solution
[Update the Software]
Update the software to the latest version according to the information provided by the developer.
